caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork apron laid flat against a plain, light beige background. The apron is composed of rectangular and square fabric patches in various colors and patterns, including shades of brown, beige, cream, blue, pink, and red. Some patches have floral motifs, while others feature geometric or abstract designs such as polka dots, checks, wavy lines, small leaf patterns, and grid lines. The apron has two long, off-white straps attached at the top corners, which extend outward in gentle curves. The center and lower part of the apron contains a prominent deep blue patch with grid lines. The overall construction consists of approximately fifteen distinct fabric pieces stitched together, forming the body of the apron. There are visible seam lines, and the top edge appears slightly gathered where the straps are affixed.
title: Colonial Pocket
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
